# Known laundering gaps for TestPositionExclusionCannotBeLaundered (internal/analyzer/position_laundering_fitness_test.go).
# Same format and reading as doctext_laundering_known_gaps.txt: rule<TAB>channel<TAB>fnv32a(tp)<TAB>note.
# The first three fields are the key; the note is for the reader. `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Every line would be a BLOCK that becomes an AUDIT because a command_position_exclude
# position excused text the command then EXECUTES (piped into a shell/interpreter, or
# written to a path the command runs or sources). Leaks that also occur with every
# position exclusion stripped are not recorded here: the test counts them separately
# ("lower-but-not-position"), because a position withdrawal cannot fix them.
#
# Empty since #3967 (2026-09-22): 52 leaks on 09a1762a (heredoc_body 42,
# interp_heredoc_literal 7, quoted_program_arg 3), 0 after the executor-reach withdrawal.
# #3976 (2026-09-23) added six substitution channels (cmdsub via bash -c and eval,
# procsub, capture-then-eval, python/awk procsub): 76 leaks with the new predicate
# disabled, 0 with it. "Empty" means empty over the channels the test probes, not
# over every way text can reach an executor.
# A new line here is a regression to explain, not an allowance.
